Progress/Status: 128 subprojects completed by 2018 and this is assessed and validated in Project Completion Report (PCR) by ADB published in Q4 2019. Data Source: DISCOs' annual report. Actual value:
Power distribution systems rehabilitated, augmented and expanded.

Additional 2,396 MVA of distribution capacity installed by 2018. Progress/Status: 3,496 MVAs added by 2018. This is assessed and validated in Project Completion Report (PCR) by ADB published in Q4 2019. Data Source: Tranche 3 project progress reports by PEPCO & DISCOs'. Actual value:

Transmission and distribution system losses reduced from 20.5% in 2012 to 19.5% in 2018. Progress/Status: Losses reduced to 17.95% by 2017. This is assessed and validated in Project Completion Report (PCR) by ADB published in Q4 2019. Data Source: DISCOs' annual report. Actual value:

274 GWh of energy saved per year starting from 2018 (baseline: 71,368 GWh in 2012). Progress/Status: 236.38 GWh of energy saved through rehabilitation of grids by 2018.
